name: annote
description: Visual feedback for coding agents. Annotate interfaces and send structured UI feedback over MCP.

scripts.build: mkdir -p dist && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && esbuild src/annotator.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=dist/annote.iife.js && cp dist/annote.iife.js dist/annotate.iife.js
scripts.mcp:build: tsc -p tsconfig.mcp.json --noEmit && esbuild packages/mcp/src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node18 --outfile=dist/mcp/cli.js && chmod +x dist/mcp/cli.js
scripts.mcp:init: npm run mcp:build && node dist/mcp/cli.js init
scripts.mcp:server: npm run mcp:build && node dist/mcp/cli.js server
scripts.mcp:doctor: npm run mcp:build && node dist/mcp/cli.js doctor
scripts.prepack: npm run build && npm run mcp:build
scripts.test: npm run test:build && node --test tests/*.mjs tests/mcp/*.mjs
